intro: The Hallowed Letter is a formal summons bearing the insignia of Priestess Anetta, delivered to promising young priests in Northshire Valley. It calls the bearer to Northshire Abbey to begin formal study and training in the Holy Light.

p: Sealed with the personal mark of Priestess Anetta, the Hallowed Letter is presented to fledgling priests after their first trials against the kobold camps of Northshire Valley. Anetta recognizes the inner spark of the Holy Light within the novice and urges them not to linger, but to step inside the abbey walls to formally dedicate themselves. With dark forces still lingering across Azeroth in the wake of the Third War, the priesthood actively gathers those capable of healing, protecting, and offering spiritual guidance to an empire struggling to maintain order.
